steps.note: R30 (Phase 4 dialogue C1, D7-1/D7-9/D7-39): debrief only, from globals. The longest-run case: Meltdown covered, so Trojan Horse is the last dark read-out, with HaX's two-line 'You knew' (correction found with the window open, not acted on) and the question between read-outs. Then the fullest site list: Mercer hostile and left standing, condemned and told he was a diversion; Elena turned; Hollis talked; Park walked out. The defended answer after a held correction isn't praised.
